description: Put a user on the free public beta's notification list for paid API keys. Ask before calling: it records the address they give you. Re-signing the same address is safe (status already_recorded). Someone who needs a higher rate limit today should email hello@hlaverify.com for a beta key instead of waiting.

source.description: Where the signup came from, e.g. mcp (optional).

use_case.description: What they would use the API for (optional). No patient details.

name: beta_signup

message.description: What to tell the user, including how to get a beta key today.

ok.description: Always true; a rejected signup comes back as an error result.

release.description: IPD-IMGT/HLA release every verdict was computed against.

status.description: already_recorded: the address was already on the list. Both are success — do not retry.
